server_version.name: axlint
server_version.title: AX Lint
server_version.description: Audit, propose, verify and confirm MCP interface improvements

tools.name: ping
tools.title: Check hosting
tools.description: Use to check AX Lint hosting: outbound HTTPS, configured secrets and access to the configured Blaxel proof sandbox. Returns no secret values.

tools.name: preview_run
tools.title: Replay S8 milestone
tools.description: Use to preview AX Lint's read-only verification viewer using the recorded live Railway run. Replays the completed S8 milestone and its recorded confirmation gates; does not run verification or apply a patch.

phase.description: Choose the complete recorded live run or an illustrative partial playback snapshot

tools.name: audit_server
tools.title: Audit MCP metadata
tools.description: Use to read live MCP tools/list and deployment identity, report deterministic metadata findings and provider-counted static tool tokens. Never executes target tools.

server_url.description: HTTP(S) MCP endpoint to inspect; only initialize and tools/list are called.

tools.name: propose_patch
tools.title: Propose description changes
tools.description: Use to propose validated description-only metadata improvements and deterministic source edits without writing files. Include every file defining accepted values or defaults, including validation constants, enums and handlers. Start with the highest-severity findings. Omit unknown facts from descriptions; return missing source facts as warnings. Requires a fresh audit.

audit.description: Fresh audit of the target; use its findings and deployment identity.

source_files.description: Include every file defining values the tools accept or default to: tool declarations, validation constants, enums and handlers. For Trackr include src/tools.ts, src/validation.ts and src/handlers.ts.

finding_ids.description: Select findings from this audit, starting with the highest severity. Prefer a focused first verification of the top findings before expanding scope.

style.description: compact (default) is concise; full includes supported examples and detail.

tools.name: verify_patch
tools.title: Verify a candidate
tools.description: Use to start single-turn baseline/candidate verification in a retained Blaxel sandbox. Returns a run_id; poll get_verification_result. Does not apply source edits.

server_url.description: Target baseline MCP endpoint; it must match the patch identity.

patch.description: Complete validated PatchSpec returned by propose_patch.

tasks.description: Pre-registered read-only task prompts and expected call predicates.

trials.description: Odd trial count from 1 to 9 per task and condition; use 3 for the provisional demo.

model.description: Use default for the configured AXLINT_MODEL; arbitrary model overrides are rejected.

tools.name: get_verification_result
tools.title: Read verification result
tools.description: Use to read retained sandbox progress and complete verification results by run_id. Returns all trials and provisional verdict, or an explicit lifecycle status. No server instance state is required.

run_id.description: Run ID returned by verify_patch; poll this same ID until complete or failed.

tools.name: confirm_patch
tools.title: Confirm deployed patch
tools.description: Use to confirm an Improved stored verification run against the same deployment on the expected new revision and exact full candidate tools/list.

server_url.description: Same MCP deployment used in the Improved verification.

run_id.description: Completed Improved verification run ID to confirm.

expected_revision.description: Exact deployed Git SHA after applying the verified candidate; must differ from baseline.
